sql:
SELECT 
    cds,
    AvgScrWrite,
    CharterNum,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Rank
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        fs.cds,
        fs.AvgScrWrite,
        sch.CharterNum
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            cds,
            AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScrWrite
         FROM 
            satscores
         GROUP BY 
            cds
         HAVING 
            AVG(AvgScrWrite) > 499) AS fs
     JOIN 
        schools AS sch ON fs.cds = sch.CDSCode
     WHERE 
        sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL) AS ranked_scores;

    satscores ss ON f."CDSCode" = ss.cds

sql:
SELECT 
    cds, 
    CharterNum, 
    AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.cds, 
        sc.CharterNum, 
        s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores AS s
    JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
) AS subquery
ORDER BY rank;

        s.AvgScrWrite
    FROM satscores AS s

) AS subquery
ORDER BY rank, 1 ASC NULLS LAST, 2 ASC NULLS LAST, 3 ASC NULLS LAST, 4 ASC NULLS LAST;

    frpm."School Name",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligibility Rate (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(satscores.NumTstTakr, 0) AS "High Scorer Rate"

sql:
WITH NormalUA AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.UA, l.Date
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE 
        (l.UA < 8.0 AND p.SEX = 'M') OR 
        (l.UA < 6.5 AND p.SEX = 'F')
),
LatestLab AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT n.ID, n.SEX, n.UA
FROM NormalUA n
JOIN LatestLab l ON n.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LatestDate = n.Date;

sql:
SELECT AVG(UA) AS Average_UA_Index
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.UA
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
    AND (p.ID, l.Date) IN (
        SELECT p.ID, MAX(l.Date) AS Latest_Lab_Date
        FROM Patient p
        JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
        WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
        GROUP BY p.ID
    )
) AS Latest_UA;
